title: coord.py carries asks and answers: two event kinds with A2A task states, the text in put values
goal: coord.py post takes the kinds ask and answer: an ask carries id, to (a session, item or agent id, or any) and ref (the coord key whose put value holds the question), an answer carries id, state (working, input-required, completed, failed or rejected, as A2A names its task states) and ref (the key of the answer text); coord.py's usage text and the kb MCP server's coord_post description list both kinds; an ask or answer with no id or ref, or an answer whose state is off that list, exits 2

notes: Plan 2026-10-18 (operator): reuse coord's shared state, not a Claude Code built-in, so any agent asks and answers: coord.py (local store or serve URL), the kb MCP server's coord tools (KB_COORD_TOOLS=1) and the coord hook. Events stay references only (coord.py:126): the text lives in a put value. The task states follow A2A (agents/a2a-protocol.md:24, DOC S2120). A served post already gets the server's operator field (coord.py usage), which tags an ask from another operator.
